title: Family of influencer who died on trip with fiancé in Zanzibar says "it doesn't make any sense"
summary: Influencer Ashly Robinson, known to her followers as Ashlee Jenae, was on a trip in Zanzibar with her fiancé when police say she was found unconscious in her luxury villa and later pronounced dead at a hospital. Her parents told CBS News the 31-year-old's death "doesn't make any sense." Her fiancé is being held for questioning.
